game.start: Welcome to Jamaica, brethren! Touch di road!
faithspen.approach: Faith's Pen up ahead! Yuh MUST stop fi di jerk chicken, nuh true?
Smell dat? Dat is Faith's Pen jerk chicken — yuh belly calling, brethren!
Nuh drive past Faith's Pen widout stopping — dat is sacrilege, seen?
faithspen.stop: Nyam done! Jerk chicken, roast yam, festival — belly full, tyre good as new!
Dat is di BEST jerk chicken pon di whole island! Road clear, tyre fix up — move!
Faith's Pen always deliver, seen? Bellied up and ready fi di rest a di road!
